title: The rules read coded classes as classes and order the split by the one time column they find
request: Fix the rules' leak finder on the solver runs' misses: online_shoppers' post-visit activity columns, fraud's Time read as a leak, letter_recognition treated as a number to predict.
spec: Four fixes: one shared rule for whole numbers that code classes; the standard plan orders its split by the one time column it found; a studied sample's planted truth names its task; the M5 builder keeps the newest solve per table and solver. online_shoppers deliberately unchanged.
plan: read the known answers before changing anything
dclab_core.analyse.coded_classes, used by _infer_task, studio.data.detect_task and the datacard
rerun the solver runs and the scripted judgment suite

decisions.decision: online_shoppers' activity columns are left to understanding, not a rule
decisions.why: its known answer depends on a session-start moment no rule can read from column names; fitting the rules to a measured sample's answer would make the measurement look better without making DCLab better; the sample's moment text lists the columns, so passing it would hand over the answer

decisions.decision: A time column the proposal found orders the split only when it really orders the rows
decisions.why: review: a duration named wait_time_min, or a chargeback date filled on fraud rows only, would otherwise become the split key

decisions.decision: A flagged column may order the split as a counter the rows follow, or as a full date whose name says nothing of after the outcome
decisions.why: fraud's elapsed Time and an event date whose outcome rate drifts are flagged by the audit yet are the right time order; a resolved_at is not

decisions.decision: The coded-classes reading says so in the task note above 20 levels
decisions.why: numbers alone cannot tell letters coded 1 to 26 from months 1 to 35; the person must see it is a reading

change: dclab_core/analyse.py (coded_classes), dclab_core/datacard.py (task reading, after_outcome_words), dclab_core 0.100.2 and CHANGELOG; dclab_rnd/studio/data.py (detect_task); dclab_rnd/intern/loop.py (found_time_column); dclab_rnd/twin/compare.py (planted task); dclab_rnd/store/sets/llm.py (newest_per_table); tests/test_task_and_time_rules.py (new), tests/test_agent_eval.py (scorecard), tests/test_store_m5_trajectories.py.

findings.defect: letter_recognition, letters coded as whole numbers 1 to 26, was proposed as regression
findings.scenario: the blind solver run scored it by mean absolute error
findings.cause: an integer outcome with more than 20 values was read as a number, in three places
findings.impact: a wrong task in a clean trajectory
alternatives: raise the limit to 30 (only moves the line)

findings.defect: the standard plan never ordered a blind table's split by the time column it found
findings.scenario: credit_card_fraud: the proposal found Time, the split stayed random
findings.cause: the time column came only from the sample's hidden known solution
findings.impact: a random split on time-ordered rows flatters the score

findings.defect: a solve with the wrong task passed its planted truth
findings.scenario: letters predicted as a number passed
findings.cause: the truth judged the target and leak columns only
findings.fix: the planted truth names the task when the solution states one
findings.impact: a wrong solve in the clean set

findings.defect: reruns piled up near-copies of one table's solve
a found time column flagged as a leak became the split key and lost its flag
findings.scenario: chargeback_at filled on fraud rows only: 318 of 3000 rows left, one class, the leakage stage failed
findings.cause: candidates were not checked against the flags
findings.fix: a flagged column orders the split only as a counter the rows follow or a full date with no after-the-outcome word; a date with gaps never
findings.impact: a broken run, or a post-outcome calendar in the model
alternatives: never adopt a flagged column (then the drifting event date of AE-11 and fraud's Time are lost)

findings.defect: a number named like a time became the split key
findings.scenario: wait_time_min, the strongest feature, dropped and the holdout made of the longest waits
findings.cause: time candidates include any number whose name matches a time word
findings.fix: a number orders the split only when it never goes down along the rows with nothing missing
findings.impact: a lost feature and a skewed holdout

findings.defect: an evenly spread whole-number quantity reads as classes
findings.cause: numbers alone cannot tell codes from an even quantity
findings.fix: the task note says it is a coded-classes reading and how to switch
findings.impact: a person may miss a wrong task
findings.open: a host should show the reading

findings.defect: a check-quick failure on 2026-10-21 was called a timing race in commit 58ccfc48
findings.cause: check-quick let the owner's OpenAI key reach the tests (fixed in bae85e29 by another session)
findings.fix: none here: the record corrects the explanation
findings.impact: live requests on the owner's key during a gate
findings.open: the owner checks the OpenAI usage of 2026-10-21

measurements.name: the scripted judgment suite, standard plan
measurements.gate: no new false alarm, and every trap caught before still caught
measurements.result: AEV-052: 2 of 13 leaks caught (the time trap added), 1 of 20 false alarms as before

measurements.name: the rules' blind solver runs on the 16 studied samples, the outcome named
measurements.gate: letter_recognition and credit_card_fraud pass with their task; online_shoppers is expected to fail
measurements.result: 15 of the 16 passed; letter_recognition as multiclass; credit_card_fraud split by Time; online_shoppers failed
measurements.next: a full-profile fraud run: the quick profile's latest slice holds too few frauds for its score to say anything

outcome: The rules predict coded classes as classes and order a blind table's split by a real time column they found, never by a suspected leak with gaps or an after-the-outcome date; the judge checks the task; one solve per table and solver is kept.
lessons: Read the known answer before calling a miss a bug: two of three misses were the task and the judge.
A guard written against one danger can remove the case it was meant to help: measure the trap suite after every guard.
risks: an evenly spread quantity read as classes
a drifting date with an innocent name that was written after the outcome
